newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land unit plans Australia venture.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land unit plans Australia venture.

text.p: DBS Land Ltd said on Tuesday its Raffles Holdings subsidiary has plans for a joint venture hotel development project in Sydney, Australia.

The company said in a statement it would hold 60 percent of the proposed project with Koala Investments Pte Ltd, a subsidiary of the Singapore investment company Temasek Holdings Pte Ltd, which will hold a 40 percent stake.
The hotel project involves the acquisition of 17 levels of a 36-storey freehold tower block to be built in central Sydney.
The Hotel Stratum will be designed as a second-tier international business class hotel and is scheduled for completion in 1999, the statement said.
A DBS Land official declined to specify the cost of the project.
The statement said DBS Land would seek shareholder approval for the proposed joint venture.
